scope: Current completion work; previous fourth-review register is historical.

items.title: ASIC specification and mating board
items.known: Gerald confirmed nominal 1.5 V, analog AC_IN and falling-edge capture. The selected interpretation uses eight returned clocks and four outgoing board clocks.
items.remaining: Confirm the physical chip/contact map, digital pad limits, input loading and unpowered behavior. Provide guaranteed clock/data delays, SPI values and reset polarity/pulse widths. IMP_TST is provisionally digital; its inactive state remains open.
items.owner: Gerald / ASIC and routing-board designers; FPGA integration checks the supplied specification.

items.title: Firmware and timing proof
items.known: Master SPI x1 boot removes two optional quad-data links. Finite raw-capture logic passes synthetic-data simulation and XC7 synthesis. A separate package/clock proof design is supplied.
items.remaining: Implement the real SPI → resets → clock startup, JTAG readout and revision-specific top level. Run Vivado placement, clock-resource, CDC and timing checks with real ASIC delays. No programmable bitstream is supplied.
items.owner: FPGA firmware / Jiaao, using the ASIC specification. Earlier ECP5 code provides a baseline; its returned-clock startup dependency and uninitialized SPI-default path need correction.

items.title: Power margins and custom input cable
items.known: The four-rail circuit, bypass parts and 12 mΩ core isolation part are selected. Current routing status is measured separately above.
items.remaining: Verify workload currents, capacitor bias, shared mounting-via paths, rail transients and heat. Build the controlled-rise, current-limited 12 V source and verify the actual cable. The source protection is not fitted to this FPGA board; the XEM8310 does not automatically provide 12 V output.
items.owner: FPGA power design and source/carrier design. The 2 A / 85 °C calculation is a screening case, not a guaranteed rating.

items.title: Assembly, stackup and connector fit
items.known: XC7A100T-1CSG324I and the Molex 467651001 port are selected. The physical proposal is JLC12161H1-1080B, 12 layers. The board outline remains 33 × 36 mm.
items.remaining: Obtain fabrication/assembly acceptance of the connector slot tolerances, small-part clearances and BGA process. Check both mezzanine mating footprints, stack height, pin-1 orientation and plug access. Verify impedance and return paths on the final routes.
items.owner: PCB/mechanical design and fabricator/assembler review. No order is authorized or placed.

items.title: Full XEM8310 acquisition link
items.known: Eight FPGA balls and eight cable contacts reserve four differential pairs. They are visibly labeled R; the receiver module is an FPGA/USB module.
items.remaining: Complete the carrier contact map, compatible voltages, receiver network, target-JTAG bridge, packet format and host-stall handling. Route the chosen link only after its electrical contract is established. This remains part of the full system, beyond the first finite capture.
items.owner: FPGA / XEM8310 carrier and acquisition-software design.

items.title: Measured operation
items.known: CAD checks and simulation are available. No assembled board has demonstrated operation.
items.remaining: After design release and assembly, check rails and current, JTAG ID, configuration recovery and clocks. Capture a known pattern, then one ASIC and all eight; measure thermal and sustained acquisition margins.
items.owner: Lab integration, using a revision-specific test procedure.
